test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the following sentence.

I like drinking __lamonade__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Lemonade**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lamonade"** is incorrect and needs correction. The correct spelling is **"lemonade"**.
 
• **Meaning:** **Lemonade **is a sweetened beverage made from lemon juice, water, and sugar. (नींबू पानी)
 
 
• **Example:** On a hot summer day, there's nothing more refreshing than a glass of homemade **lemonade**.
 
 

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lemonaid**: Incorrect spelling of lemonade.
 
• **Lemenade**: Incorrect spelling of lemonade.
 
• **Limonade**: Incorrect spelling of lemonade.
